title: (RHEA-2023:1233) OpenShift Virtualization 4.10.8 Images
portal_summary: Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization release 4.10.8 is now available with updates to packages and images that fix several bugs and add enhancements.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Container Native Virtualization|Red Hat Container Native Virtualization|4.10|x86_64
Red Hat Container Native Virtualization|Red Hat Container Native Virtualization|4.10|x86_64
portal_solution:

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
